claim_text: The NSA says it had a temporary degradation during routine maintenance
summary: The NSA said on Nov 17 that it had a temporary degradation during scheduled routine maintenance, that some internal systems were affected, and that mission-critical capabilities stayed fully operational.
detail: The statement does not name the network, the cause or a time for full service. nsa.gov blocks automated access, so the text was read through search results and outlets that quote it in full.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The NSA's own Nov 17 statement says this; The Record and NBC News quote it word for word.

claim_text: The DNI blamed patching for PHP flaws
summary: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton said on Nov 17 that patching for recently found PHP vulnerabilities caused some NSA systems not to come back up as expected.
detail: He said it in a Fox Business interview, quoted by The Record and CBS News. This confirms what the DNI said, not the technical detail, which the NSA has not published.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Two independent outlets quote the same on-air remark: the patching 'caused some of these systems to not come back up' and 'that is what has happened at the NSA today'.

claim_text: The DNI says the recent outages were not a cyberattack
summary: The White House published remarks on Nov 18 in which the DNI says the recent outages are not a cyberattack and not a coordinated nation-state effort, but disruptions from patching and upgrades.
detail: The remarks cover the recent run of outages in general; the NSA disruption is among the outages the DNI was asked about that week.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The White House release quotes the DNI: 'This is not a cyberattack, and this is not a coordinated effort by a nation state.'

claim_text: The DNI told Congress there is no indication of an outside attacker
summary: At a House Homeland Security Committee hearing on Nov 18, the DNI said the outages were separate, tied to maintenance and technical changes, and that there was no indication of external or state-sponsored actors at the NSA.
detail: Asked directly about the NSA, he said he had to protect the agency and spoke of routine patching, upgrading and hardware work rather than naming one cause.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: CBS News, ABC News and PBS each report his testimony, including 'They are not a coordinated or state-sponsored attack.'

claim_text: US agencies urged immediate patching of PHP flaws in October
summary: On Oct 21, CISA, the FBI and the NSA urged organizations to patch two critical PHP flaws known as PHP2Shell right away, or take affected systems offline.
detail: The flaws are CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619. CISA added both to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on Oct 26.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: CISA's alert names the two CVEs, urges immediate patching and says to take PHP systems offline if they cannot be patched.

claim_text: The network was still partly down on Nov 19
summary: Two outlets reported that the NSA's internal network was still down or unstable on Thursday, Nov 19, the third day, and that most headquarters staff were told to stay home.
detail: Both reports rest on unnamed people with knowledge of the matter. The NSA has not said when full service will return. CBS News reported on Nov 18 that the network was back up, so accounts differ.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: NBC News and MS NOW each report, from unnamed sources, that staff were told to work from home for a third day.

claim_text: Staff arrivals were staggered and only essential staff were asked in
summary: Outlets reported staggered arrivals at Fort Meade from Nov 17 to limit how many people logged in at once, and a 'code orange' status on Nov 19 asking only essential staff to report.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: The Record and MS NOW describe the staggered arrivals and the reason, citing unnamed sources.

claim_text: An NSA site in Georgia was also affected
summary: Outlets reported that the disruption also reached an NSA site in Georgia that supports work focused on the Middle East.
detail: First reported by CNN; NBC News and MS NOW report it from their own sources.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: NBC News and MS NOW each say the outage affected a worksite in Georgia, citing unnamed sources.

claim_text: Sources say intelligence collection kept working
summary: Unnamed sources told outlets the outage was an inconvenience but did not stop the NSA's intelligence collection or cybersecurity work.
detail: This matches the NSA's own statement that mission-critical capabilities stayed operational.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: NBC News and MS NOW report from unnamed sources that collection systems stayed up.

claim_text: Which day the network first failed
summary: Most outlets say the network went down on Tuesday, Nov 17; one unnamed source told MS NOW it crashed on Monday, Nov 16.
label: Unverified
why_it_supports: The Record and others say Tuesday; MS NOW's source says Monday. No official source gives a start time.

claim_text: Officials say the recent outages are not linked
summary: The DNI and Secretary Rubio said the recent outages, including the FAA ground stop and the Microsoft outage, are separate incidents with no sign of a common cause or attacker.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The White House release quotes Secretary Rubio: 'We have no indication, no evidence, and no reason to believe at all that any of these incidents are related to each other.'
